verdict.rationale: Riveter lets you check run status (/runs/{id}, Runs.List filtered by status) and register a webhook_url that receives POSTs on run.completed, run.stopped and run.finished events. That gives basic job monitoring and completion notifications, but there is no documented failure-specific alert, no performance metrics, and no data-quality validation (dry_run only validates the request and estimates credits). missing for 10: job performance metrics or dashboards, data-quality validation of results, explicit failure alerting, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can monitor job performance, validate data quality, and receive alerts when something fails

citations.quote: Pass webhook_url in the JSON body when starting a run and Riveter POSTs the full results to your URL when it finishes (events: run.completed, run.stopped, run.finished).
